home.strip.aria: How we work, in one line
home.strip.1: We put no advertising in our products
home.strip.2: Our products work without an account
home.strip.3: We do not track how you use them
home.strip.4: You can leave without losing your data
home.work.noctis_lead: Noctis runs each of your servers on the engine it needs and sends only your browser through the tunnel.
home.work.aria2t_lead: Aria2t gives the aria2 engine a proper interface, in the browser and in the terminal.
home.work.next_own: a problem we want to solve
home.work.next_lead: We will spend a season on the next product if it solves a problem we face ourselves.
home.how.p1_t: We build the tools we need
home.how.p1_b: Every product so far began with a task one of us could not finish with the tools at hand. We keep using each one on our own machines after release, so we hit its rough edges before you do.
home.how.p2_b: We refine the small things until a release feels right. Then we ship it, and the next round of polish goes into an update.
home.how.p3_t: We read every message with care
home.how.p3_b: A person reads each message in full, whether it reports a problem or suggests an idea. We plan our next work around what you tell us.
home.how.p4_b: We want our products to look good, and we keep a visual choice only when it makes the tool easier to read or quicker to use.
home.how.p5_b: When a well-tested engine solves the hard problem, we build on it and put our effort into the parts you touch. When none fits, we write that part ourselves.
home.floor.f1_t: It's yours, and it stays yours
home.floor.f1_b: You can export what you put in as readable data. We do not use it to build a profile of you.
home.floor.f2_b: We put no advertising in our products and take no payment to favor someone else's interests.
home.floor.f3_t: You can read what it does before you trust it
home.floor.f3_b: We document each behavior that can affect your trust, next to the product that performs it.
home.floor.f4_t: It keeps working if we stop
home.floor.f4_b: If we retire a product, installed copies keep working on their current machines. We will announce the decision before support ends.
